claims.statement: Structured disclosure of AI contribution to authored work is itself a Matawaka novelty claim.
overlap_summary: Multiple public predecessors classify or report AI participation in human-authored work.
Several predecessors retain human accountability rather than equating machine contribution with authorship.
forbidden_claims: Matawaka or UU-AAP was the first framework to disclose human/AI contribution.
Human accountability in AI-assisted authorship originated with UU-AAP.
required_next_evidence: Treat these works as related work rather than novelty support.
Compare only narrower machine-verifiable governance semantics if claiming differentiation.

claims.statement: Separating artifact provenance, identity, consent/permission, and authorization is itself a Matawaka novelty claim.
overlap_summary: CAWG and external C2PA proposals already model identity, endorsement/consent and provenance as orthogonal assertion surfaces.
The March 2026 digital-likeness proposal states the permission-state gap explicitly and uses the phrase 'Provenance is not permission.'
claims.surviving_narrow_claim: Matawaka may still differ in enforcing non-escalation across a larger set of decision/action semantics, but the basic separation itself is prior public work.
forbidden_claims: Matawaka first discovered that provenance is not permission.
C2PA/CAWG lacked any pre-UU-AAP separation of provenance, identity and consent/authorization-like evidence.
required_next_evidence: Compare exact composition/failure semantics rather than labels alone.
Keep C2PA/CAWG source-status boundaries explicit.

claims.statement: A deterministic pre-action boundary that authorizes an exact AI-agent effect before execution is itself a Matawaka novelty claim.
overlap_summary: Multiple public predecessors separate access/workload identity from action authorization.
Several bind exact action scope, policy/frontier state, validity and anti-replay before an external effect.
FERZ explicitly frames the missing MCP/gateway authorization boundary months before public UU-AAP.
forbidden_claims: Matawaka invented the AI Agent Action Gateway concept.
Matawaka was first to require authorization before an AI-agent external effect.
Matawaka first separated access authorization from action authorization.
ActionPermit alone establishes novelty.
required_next_evidence: Treat the action gate as reuse/convergence unless a narrower semantic property is being evaluated.
Cite maturity differences: preprints, industry announcements and individual I-Ds are not consensus standards.

claims.statement: Signed delegation chains with bounded scope and monotonic narrowing are themselves a Matawaka novelty claim.
overlap_summary: Predecessors already encode principal/mission/action scope and delegation chains.
AgentROA and related work explicitly constrain downstream scope rather than allowing delegation to broaden authority.
forbidden_claims: Matawaka invented cryptographically bounded agent delegation.
Monotonic delegation narrowing is unique to Matawaka.
required_next_evidence: Use these mechanisms as related work and compare only Matawaka-specific semantic composition rules.

claims.statement: Post-action receipts that record execution or observed effects are themselves a Matawaka novelty claim.
overlap_summary: Public predecessors already record execution, governance events and outcomes separately from pre-action authorization.
Some explicitly separate attempt/execution evidence from stronger claims about effect or causality.
claims.surviving_narrow_claim: The exact UU-AAP transition from ActionPermit to ActionReceipt to OutcomeReceipt to SuccessorStateReceipt may still be a narrower composition candidate, but receipt existence itself is crowded.
forbidden_claims: Matawaka invented post-action agent receipts.
Recording what an agent actually did is unique to UU-AAP.
required_next_evidence: Compare execution-attempt, confirmed-effect, observed-outcome and successor semantics separately.
Add Agent Action Capsule family to the source ledger before making a narrower action/outcome claim.

claims.statement: Append-only transparency, witness cosigning or external anchoring for non-equivocation is itself a Matawaka novelty claim.
overlap_summary: SCITT is an IETF consensus architecture for signed statements and transparent services.
The C2PA external discussion independently decomposes manifest signing, append-only consistency, witness/anchor evidence and non-equivocation.
forbidden_claims: Matawaka invented transparency logs for AI provenance.
Witnessed checkpoints or external anchoring are novel Matawaka primitives.
required_next_evidence: Position Matawaka transparency work as executable interoperability/reuse evidence rather than core novelty.

claims.statement: Preserving evidence or context available at decision time together with a decision trace is itself a Matawaka novelty claim.
overlap_summary: Several predecessors capture per-decision inputs/context, policy evaluation, trace and outcome information.
Auditable LLM Autonomy explicitly requires provenance/freshness-aware evidence and separates evidence, decision trace and outcome.
claims.surviving_narrow_claim: PoAI's stronger candidate is not decision-time evidence in general, but explicit separation of heterogeneous resource existence/provenance, availability, consideration and authority/responsibility.
forbidden_claims: PoAI was first to ask what information was available when a decision was made.
Decision provenance originated with PoAI.
required_next_evidence: Search decision-science, provenance, legal audit and safety literature for explicit available-versus-considered resource sets.
Do not conflate consumed inputs with all relevant available intelligence.

claims.statement: Composing heterogeneous identity, delegation, policy, approval, transparency, capability and execution evidence for one action is itself a Matawaka novelty claim.
overlap_summary: EP-AEC directly composes heterogeneous authorization evidence while retaining native validity and action binding.
Principal/Verifier Binding and CVA separately insist that identity, authority/delegation, request binding and execution evidence are different verifiable claims.
claims.surviving_narrow_claim: A broader semantic non-escalation rule may survive if it covers evidence, availability, consideration, intent, authority, responsibility, coordination, permission, action, outcome, causality and truth rather than authorization evidence alone.
forbidden_claims: Matawaka was first to compose heterogeneous agent authorization receipts.
Receipt composition by itself is a novel Matawaka concept.
required_next_evidence: Perform exact field/transition comparison with EP-AEC and verifier-binding drafts.
Formally specify what semantic dimensions exist outside their authorization-evidence scope.

claims.statement: A provider-neutral rule prevents valid evidence from silently acquiring stronger semantic power through heterogeneous composition unless an explicit typed transition establishes the stronger claim.
overlap_summary: Pre-publication sources already separate several claim classes and warn against overclaiming from valid evidence.
EP-AEC prevents SATISFIED authorization evidence from becoming universal authorization or execution/outcome proof.
Stored Is Not Supported is a post-publication convergence signal that explicitly prevents persistence from upgrading epistemic standing.
claims.surviving_narrow_claim: The candidate contribution is the generalized cross-domain semantic non-escalation contract over the full UU-AAP/PoAI lifecycle, not the narrower observation that some claims are distinct.
forbidden_claims: No prior system separated semantic claims before Matawaka.
Semantic non-escalation is established as a world-first contribution.
The post-publication Stored Is Not Supported paper proves Matawaka priority or influence.
required_next_evidence: Define a formal lattice or typed transition system for permitted semantic strengthening.
Test composition hostile cases where individually valid receipts would create an invalid stronger aggregate claim.
Broaden prior-art search beyond agent protocols into evidence logic, information-flow type systems and provenance calculi.

claims.statement: Every typed receipt carries machine-readable positive assertions plus explicit negative semantic boundaries describing material claims it does not establish.
overlap_summary: External predecessors contain explicit semantic limitations and narrow verdict meanings.
The bounded audit has not yet found an earlier provider-neutral common receipt envelope that normatively requires machine-readable non-effects across every lifecycle primitive.
claims.surviving_narrow_claim: A common typed receipt contract in which non-effects are first-class machine semantics may be a distinct Matawaka contribution if broader provenance/type-system prior art does not already materialize the same structure.
forbidden_claims: Explicit non-effects are proven novel or patentable.
No earlier evidence system encoded negative assertions or limitations.
Absence from this bounded search proves absence from prior art.
required_next_evidence: Search formal provenance, negative claims, closed-world attestations, proof-carrying authorization and refinement-type literature.
Define canonical machine semantics for contradiction between assertions and non-effects.
Demonstrate why prose-only limitations are insufficient for safe composition.

claims.statement: PoAI models heterogeneous intelligence resources with resource provenance, availability and consideration separately from decision authority and responsibility.
overlap_summary: Prior systems record evidence/context used or available around a decision and sometimes bind it cryptographically.

The bounded corpus has not yet produced an exact predecessor for a heterogeneous resource set whose provenance, availability and consideration are first-class states and whose epistemic advantage cannot imply authority/responsibility.
claims.surviving_narrow_claim: Available Intelligence != Considered Intelligence != Authority is a plausible distinct research contribution when applied compositionally to human, AI, documentary, model, expert-group and institutional resources.
forbidden_claims: PoAI invented decision-time evidence.
PoAI is established as the first system to distinguish available and considered information.
A resource listed in PoAI is thereby proven available, used, authoritative or true.
required_next_evidence: Search cognitive decision science, legal discovery/audit, information-set models, data lineage and human-factors literature.
Create hostile fixtures for available-not-considered, considered-not-relied-upon, unavailable-but-cited and epistemic-advantage-without-authority cases.
Define whether 'materially influenced' is a separate layer from consideration.

claims.statement: One provider-neutral typed protocol preserves explicit transitions from State/Evidence through Availability, Intent, Authority/Responsibility, Coordination and Action Gate to Outcome/Successor State, with no implicit cross-layer transitions.
overlap_summary: The Sato/SOOS family provides serious predecessor pressure with separate intent, mandate, human escalation, execution and audit primitives.
EP-AEC composes many authorization evidence types and Permit Receipts supplies a strong effect boundary.
Auditable LLM Autonomy independently separates evidence, decision trace and outcome.
claims.surviving_narrow_claim: The exact seven-layer combination may remain distinct if Availability, Responsibility, Coordination, explicit non-effects and successor-state semantics form one provider-neutral contract rather than a runtime-specific family of adjacent mechanisms.
forbidden_claims: No prior architecture linked intent, authorization, human escalation, execution and audit before UU-AAP.
The seven-layer stack is established as globally novel merely because no exact name match was found.
required_next_evidence: Perform a component-by-component comparison against the complete Sato/SOOS draft family and EP-AEC.
Search workflow/protocol calculi outside AI for equivalent typed state-to-effect-to-successor semantics.
Prove that removing any candidate-distinguishing layer causes a semantic ambiguity that the predecessor families do not already solve.

claims.statement: The same semantic discipline spans human-AI authorship/governance and externally consequential autonomous-agent action rather than treating the two as unrelated accountability domains.
overlap_summary: The bounded landscape contains mature clusters for authorship accountability and for autonomous action authorization, but they are largely separate bodies of work.
No exact earlier framework was found in this bounded audit that uses one typed semantic non-escalation architecture across both domains.
claims.surviving_narrow_claim: Cross-domain reuse of one explicit evidence/availability/intent/authority/responsibility/action/outcome semantics is a plausible system-level novelty candidate.
forbidden_claims: Absence of an exact earlier cross-domain framework is proof of novelty.
UU-AAP subsumes or replaces C2PA, CAWG, agent authorization standards or authorship-reporting frameworks.
required_next_evidence: Search accountable-computing, workflow provenance, safety-case and socio-technical governance literature for cross-domain analogues.
Build paired conformance fixtures showing the same invariant preventing semantic escalation in authorship and agent-action cases.

claims.statement: An AI-facing gateway that agents can call before consequential tool use is itself a Matawaka novelty claim.
overlap_summary: MCP/gateway authorization boundaries, human-confirmation protocol surfaces and runtime execution enforcement already predate the public Matawaka gateway issue.
The presence of an agent-callable enforcement/gateway interface therefore cannot carry a broad novelty claim.
claims.surviving_narrow_claim: Matawaka can still evaluate whether agents voluntarily select a semantically richer evidence/authority gateway under consequential uncertainty, but that is an empirical adoption/evaluation claim rather than origin of the gateway pattern.
forbidden_claims: Matawaka invented the agent-callable action gateway.
MCP lacked any proposed human/action authorization boundary before Matawaka.
required_next_evidence: Frame future paired evals as comparative effectiveness evidence, not novelty evidence.
